rewritten.newManifestation: State restoration fails for historical events after validation rules change.
A read-only status request returns an error after any historical event fails restoration.
A constant three-line response is passed through a truncation check configured for 2000 lines or 50 KB.
Total event-copy work grows quadratically with history length.
One correction commit can advance the recurrence counter twice when recorded under two descriptive abstractions.
A record added after a correction is counted as a later recurrence even when its commit predates that correction.
Restoration acceptance changes when object-key order differs after the storage round trip.
An unstubbed runtime import resolves to an undefined value in tests that use a one-function full-package test double.
An error produced by the terminal recurrence state does not identify which aggregate group triggered that state.
